japanese: 第１段ブースターユニットをジェットソン。
ツーダッシュ！作戦遂行を最優先！
english: 02-Dash, completing the mission takes top priority!

japanese: とどめに攻撃目標たるコアブロックも捕捉できない。
english: Worst of all, we cannot isolate the attacking targets' core blocks.
The 83rd line is ablaze! Extinguishing the fire is impossible!

japanese: フライホイール圧着板ロック解除。
english: Releasing locks on the flywheel crimp.

japanese: ずーっとガマンしてたし。
english: I've been holding it in all these years.

japanese: 偏屈でバカな顔してた。
english: He hasn't changed at all. He still has that stupid lowly face.

japanese: 同じ事を何度も繰り返す。自分がいいなって感じられるまでね。
君が初号機と同化している間に起こったサードインパクトの結果だよ。
english: The outcome of Third Impact, which came to pass while you were merged with Eva-01.

japanese: 安らかな魂の浄化を願う。
english: We wish for Human Instrumentality, the peaceful purification of all souls.

japanese: 疑似シン化形態を超えている！
最後の決戦を挑むヴィレ。
english: Wille make one last grueling stand to prevent Final Impact.

japanese: シン・エヴァンゲリオン劇場版：｜｜
english: Next Time  New Evangelion Theatrical Edition: ||
